response.original_title: How do I know if I need surgery, radiation, or chemotherapy?
response.overview: The treatment for head and neck cancer depends on the type, location, size, and stage of the cancer. Your doctor will review your biopsy, scans, and other test results before deciding whether you may need surgery, radiation therapy, chemotherapy, or a combination of treatments. Surgery may be recommended when the cancer can be removed safely. A head and neck cancer surgeon may also plan reconstruction when needed to help maintain important functions such as speaking, eating, and swallowing. Radiation therapy may be given after surgery to reduce the chance of cancer coming back, or it may be used as the main treatment in some cases. Chemotherapy may also be used with radiation or other treatments depending on the cancer and its stage. If you are looking for a head and neck cancer surgeon in Ahmedabad, a specialist can review your reports and explain the treatment options suitable for your condition.
